format: JavaScript (Node.js module, ES6 syntax with import/export)
description: This script is used for build automation within a project, handling tasks such as cleaning up symbolic links, invoking build commands via pnpm, and processing build output for unresolved imports and runtime issues.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules within extensions directories of the project to clean up stale links.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes specific runtime symlinks in dist and dist-runtime directories to prepare for rebuilds.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Analyzes build output lines to detect unresolved import errors outside allowed paths.
